title: Puharich's journal lists the names of the space kids
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Puharich's journal lists the names of the space kids, about 1970s at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: actually in fact, in one of his journals he like wrote all the names of the kids at the time.

plain: A researcher speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels says that Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA, the US intelligence agency, kept journals in the 1970s, and that in one of them he wrote down the names of all the "space kids", the children he worked with who were said to have psychic gifts. If true, the journal would be a written record of who those children were.
